description: This file defines the 'ClaimAttachment' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing attachments associated with claims. It includes properties like request ID, attachment ID, size, description, filename, the attachment content, file type, associated user, and attachment timestamp. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map class properties to the database schema and employs traits and decorators for additional functionality.

classes.name: ClaimAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a claim attachment, encapsulating attachment metadata and content, mapped to the 'ohrm_claim_attachment' database table.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with this attachment.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID for this attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment file.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment file.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the attachment content or resource.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type or file type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type or file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user who attached the file.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a user with this attachment.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the attachment was linked.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time of attachment.
